maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from new infrastructure construction projects (roads, bridges, water) and construction materials like aggregates and asphalt, not repair-led.

publicly_funded.reason: Most revenue from transportation and water infrastructure projects for state, federal and local agencies; some private clients and materials.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by winning construction projects and organic materials business; occasional acquisitions like Kenny Seng, Layne, Warren Paving, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Public agencies award projects by competitive bidding or qualification; contractors and aggregates are replaceable between projects without re-qualification.

notes: Public share of revenue is judged from general knowledge that most work is for government agencies; website says public and private clients.
